name: swagger-film-manager
description: REST APIs for the interaction with the Film Manager service.

scripts.generate: rimraf generated && openapi-generator-cli generate -i api/openapi.json -g nodejs-express-server -t openapi-templates -o generated --global-property apis,supportingFiles=openapi.yaml,apiTests=false,apiDocs=false && rimraf generated/services generated/utils generated/.openapi-generator
